name: swarm
description: Swarm by Swarms.so: AI teammates with computer use, connected apps, memory, and voice.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test:mcp: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/mcp.test.mts tests/mcp-isolated-transport.test.mts && node tests/mcp-chat.mjs
scripts.test:performance: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/latency.test.mts tests/vm-image.test.mts tests/viewer-ready.test.mts && node tests/vm-performance.mjs && node tests/viewer-wake.mjs
scripts.test:openrouter: node --import tsx --test tests/openrouter.test.mts && npm run build -w web && node tests/openrouter-ui.mjs
scripts.test:cli: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/cli-catalog.test.mts tests/cli-runner.test.mts tests/cli-native-runner.test.mts tests/cli-native-transport.test.mts tests/cli-native-isolated-transport.test.mts tests/cli-native-tools.test.mts tests/cli-runtime.test.mts tests/cli-login-runner.test.mts tests/cli-login.test.mts tests/cli-subscription.test.mts tests/cli-concurrency.test.mts tests/cli-hosted-concurrency.test.mts tests/cli-supervisor.test.mts && node tests/cli-chat.mjs
